=== zapp.update_segment_counts() [] SCALAR void
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.update_segment_counts()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp', 'monitoring'
AS $function$
DECLARE seg record; v_count int;
BEGIN
  FOR seg IN SELECT id, filters, instance_name FROM zapp.contact_segments LOOP
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM zapp.get_segment_contacts(seg.id, 100000, 0);
    UPDATE zapp.contact_segments
    SET contact_count = v_count, updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = seg.id;
  END LOOP;
END;
$function$
